dedupe_keys.name: lf energy compas open source iec 61850 substation configuration and profile management

description: CoMPAS (Configuration Modules for Power industry Automation Systems) develops open-source software for configuring the protection, automation and control systems of digital substations built on the IEC 61850 standard. It is an LF Energy project, the first of its Digital Substation special interest group. Coverage: generic tools for any IEC 61850 substation. Components include services that store and validate SCL (substation configuration language) files against IEC 61850 profiles and plugins for the OpenSCD browser editor, delivered as Docker-based microservices with a lightweight web client. Format and access: source code in the com-pas GitHub organisation, container images and REST interfaces; free. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: the tools manage configuration files and profiles, not operational data, and utilities must supply their own substation models; parts are still maturing. Simulation uses: producing and checking consistent IEC 61850 substation models that feed digital twin and cyber-physical cascading failure studies of the grid, including cyber security testbeds. Related records: the IEC 61850 GOOSE security dataset (data-iec61850-goose-security-dataset-adsc) and SANDI-2024 substation traffic (data-sandi-2024-substation-intrusion-detection) are network data from substations of this kind.
